useWhen: Portable study validation, executor-neutral planning and classified evaluation
avoidWhen: Browser operation, participant recruitment or inferring observed success from a plan

outputs.result: native validation/plan/evaluation summary; host owns private evidence

validation.runtime: native descriptors source-inspected; launcher fail-closed paths tested; MCP startup/execution not tested

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; client installation and execution are not qualified. Wildcard versions do not establish runtime compatibility.

launchResolution.behavior: Resolve both absolute paths before native client config. Launcher refuses dirty or wrong-revision checkout, changes cwd and execs installed kbb -M:mcp; never bootstraps dependencies.
